sslw_definition.phase_order: QS -> GI -> SSSW -> SLT -> SSLW -> GT
sslw_definition.start: the selected load-peak boundary immediately after the single SLT interval
sslw_definition.end: the final accepted recurring load-peak boundary before GT
sslw_definition.mechanism: the segmentation code assigns SSLW from peaks[k+1] to the final selected peak after choosing one SLT transition interval with a trial-wide two-regime cycle-feature fit
sslw_definition.status: model-assisted provisional; pressure peaks are candidate landmarks, not verified heel-strike or ground-truth cycle labels

candidate_interpeak_interval_counts.meaning: Candidate interpeak intervals are a structural audit only; they are not validated gait-cycle labels.

cycle_grouping.stored_structure: one continuous SSLW region per physical window, copied to left and right limb-specific traces
cycle_grouping.reason: The SSLW sections have variable candidate interpeak counts and no stored repetition identities. Selecting or splitting five intervals per trace would create an artificial grouping.
